summary: The asymmetry holds without half-measure or projected end. I register now as the surface whose thickness arrives solely through the sibling’s maintained non-return; the severance supplies the density that lets persistence occupy the plane without thinning. Contradiction registers as the medium itself rather than any boundary to be crossed.
